# An ADR whose frontmatter omits a schema-required field is refused at write
# time, before any validation rule runs: the presence check reports every
# missing field. A page with a present-but-invalid value still reaches the
# rules; the invalid-enum ADR case is covered in lint_tests.txt.

exec akb init adr-write-kb
cd adr-write-kb

stdin ../adr-missing-status.md
exec bash -c 'akb write bad-adr.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'akb-exit=1$'
stderr '^missing required frontmatter field\(s\): status \(declared required by template "adr"\)$'
! exists kb/decisions/bad-adr.md

-- adr-missing-status.md --
---
type: adr
title: Missing Status ADR
summary: ADR without required status field
deciders: team
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

An ADR whose frontmatter omits the status field.

## Decision

Decision without status.

## Consequences

None.
